findings.description: In the continuous wide shot the waitress is standing behind the counter wiping it, then within ~0.5-1 s her body slides through the counter and she is seated on a customer stool beside the trucker, with no walk around the counter end. Dense frames around 01:20.4-01:21.4 show her legs appearing on the customer side while her torso is still at the counter position.

While the waitress moves along the near end of the counter, a second identical woman (same light-blue shirt, apron, hair bun) materializes at the far end of the counter near the kitchen pass and remains there through 01:57. The diner previously contained only one waitress and the trucker has left, so the second figure is an unexplained clone.

At 01:51 the waitress is on the customer (stool) side leaning over the counter; by 01:52-01:53 she is behind the counter with her back to camera, having passed through the near end of the counter rather than walking around it (legs visible on the customer side in one frame, behind the counter in the next).

The waitress is seen in profile looking out the window in a light-blue shirt, but her reflection in the glass faces the camera frontally, sits at a different position, and wears a tan/olive shirt with a darker apron. The reflection does not match the person casting it (also visible as a large ghost face over the truck in 01:42-01:45).

The opening establishes a white semi tractor parked beside the diner, but the vehicle the trucker walks to and climbs into is a dark-green box truck with chrome stacks and a different cab. No other vehicle was established.

The first interior shot (00:10-00:18) shows the left window glowing bright white like daylight, while the adjacent exterior shot and the following interior wide (00:18+) show a deep-blue night/dusk sky outside the same windows.

The trucker first appears behind the counter next to the kitchen pass beside the waitress, then walks out along the counter into the customer aisle. He seems to emerge from the staff/kitchen area rather than entering through a customer door, even though he arrives as a customer by truck.

The exterior shows a small box-shaped building with no visible booths, and no neon sign until a red sign pops into the window at about 00:10. The interior wide shot shows a long room with a row of window booths, two neon signs, and another building across the lot. The interior layout and signage do not match the exterior.

In the reverse angle from behind the counter, the trucker sits at a short straight counter section beside a glass refrigerator and an exit door. The wide shots establish him at the curved front counter with booths and the windows behind him, so the two angles don't describe the same geography.
